# Graveyard hilltop: a 12-sided slab (r 5.5) with a flat top at z 0 (a pale path and dark patches painted in a
# 24 px texture), a ragged rim, and a rocky underside tapering below. Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Top --vertices 12 --radius 5.5 --depth 0.6 --location 0 0 -0.3
material new Ground --base-color 1 1 1
material new Rock --base-color 0.337 0.353 0.459 --no-slot
material slot add
active Top
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
material assign Rock
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Ground base-color textures/ground.png
add mesh cone --name Under --vertices 12 --radius1 0.9 --radius2 5.4 --depth 2.6 --location 0 0 -1.9
material assign Rock
active Under
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.5"
randomize --amount 0.4 --seed 11
mode object
select all
shade flat
export hill.glb
